div.div: آدَرُ (T, S, M, Mgh, Msb, K) and ↓ مَأْدُورٌ (M, K) A man (S) [having a scrotal hernia; or] having an inflation in the خُصْيَة [or the testicle, or the scrotum]: (T, * S:) or having an inflation of the خُصْيَة: (Msb:) or having his صِفَاق [or inner skin] ruptured, so that [some of] his intestines fall into his scrotum; the rupture being in every instance only in the left side: or afflicted by a rupture in one of his خُصْيَانِ [or in either half of the scrotum]: (M, K:) or having a largeness of the خُصَى (Mgh:) pl. of the former, أُدُرٌ; (Msb, K;) and of the latter, مَآدِيرُ. (K.) Accord. to some, (M,) أَدْرَآءُ خُصْيَةٌ signifies [A testicle, or scrotum,] large, without rupture. (M, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
